notes.title: Polyducks name change.
notes.notes: [p]Polyducks is in the process of being renamed to Poly Ducklings.[/p]

notes.title: Polyducks Storepage is Now Live! - Wishlist Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645888/49ef2891d8d79a49542020b8722e54f266081f0d.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 👋

I'm thrilled to finally make the [b]Polyducks[/b] store page live on Steam!

Polyducks is inspired by Pikmin, but focuses on cozy, relaxing gameplay centered around puzzles, strategy, and time management. You’ll command adorable polyducks to carry treasure blocks back to your base, solving puzzles along the way. Unlike many strategy games, Polyducks emphasizes calm exploration and thoughtful planning rather than combat, delivering a peaceful, atmospheric experience.

[b]-----------------------------[/b]

[b]🎉 Wishlist and Follow![/b]

Polyducks is now open for wishlisting!  
Be sure to [b]wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] to get all the latest updates.

[b]-----------------------------[/b]

Polyducks also has a YouTube channel and a Discord server where you can join the community and follow development progress.

[b]🚀 Demo Coming Soon![/b]  

I'm almost finished with a demo! It includes 12 levels that showcase the core gameplay mechanics, as well as a fully functional level creator where you can build and save your own stages.

Check out the trailer below for a sneak peek:
